name: Tebar: Telegram alert when a post fails

parameters.content:
## Failed post alert
When a post fails on an account (after Tebar's last retry), you get a Telegram message with the platform and the reason.

**Setup**
1. **Post failed**: pick a Tebar credential made with an owner API key (not limited to one workspace).
2. **Send to Telegram**: pick your Telegram bot credential and put your chat ID.
3. Activate the workflow. Tebar only sends to https URLs, so self-hosted n8n needs a public `WEBHOOK_URL`.

parameters.text: =Post failed on {{ $json.data.platform }} Reason: {{ String($json.data.error_message ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>') }} ({{ $json.data.error_code }}) Open Tebar: https://publish.tebar.app/posts?view=list&section=history
